name: (Mini Update) Super Toilet Fight
desc:
🚽 Welcome to Super Toilet Fight 💥

Art By K_A
Model By Jussis


🎮 How to Play
Fight toilets to earn Points. 🚽
If all players die during a wave, the game will reset and start a new wave. 🌊
Each mode becomes progressively more difficult. 😈
Collect Points to unlock new weapons and characters. 🔒

👥 Join Our Community Group

Join our Roblox Group to stay updated with the latest news, updates, and events!

Group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/1039911008/Super-Toilet-Fight#!/about

Good luck, and have fun! 💥

20000 LIKES = UPDATE 👍
